edits.current:
# The promotion and source-history suites read Git history; the only
      # archive payloads either test opens are the retained value-index
      # archives, so everything else stays an index or a root record.
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

filter: blob:none
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/*/
            /.github/
            /acceptance/
            /config/
            /containers/
            /demos/
            /nix/
            /notices/
            /patches/
            /poc/
            /schema/
            /scripts/
            /site/
            /src/
            /tests/
            /docs/
            !/docs/evidence/*
            /docs/evidence/*.json
            /docs/evidence/*.md
            /docs/evidence/*.xml
            /docs/evidence/*/index.json
            /docs/evidence/checked-record-value-index-*/
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
- name: Check out complete history and the exact optional-parameter corpus
edits.previous: - name: Check out complete source history

edits.current:
sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/*/
            /.github/
            /schema/
            /scripts/
            /site/
            /src/
            /tests/
            /docs/
            !/docs/evidence/*
            /docs/evidence/optional-parameter-hosted-20261029/
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - name: Require complete immutable source history
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" = false
          git cat-file -e 496de9b6f22725da76e2fbe3aba9a2a1dd76ce06^{commit}
          git cat-file -e faf28c4216c0b68a742d4e5f6119432d78912e2f^{commit}

, source.replace("          fetch-depth: 0\n"
			, "          fetch-depth: 1\n")
		, source.replace("          filter: blob:none\n", "")
		, source.replace("          persist-credentials: false\n"
			, "          persist-credentials: true\n")
		, source.replace("            !/docs/evidence/*\n", "")
		, source.replace(
			"            /docs/evidence/optional-parameter-hosted-20261029/\n"
			, "            /docs/evidence/\n")
		, source.replace("          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false\n"
			, "          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: true\n")
		, ...auditSparseRoots.map(root => source.replace(
			`            /${root}/\n`, ""))
		, source.replace("          test \"$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)\" = false\n", "")
		, source.replace(producerRevision, "0".repeat(40))
		, source.replace(archiveRevision, "0".repeat(40))

scope: Retain complete Git reachability while materializing only the exact optional-parameter and value-index evidence corpora their recurring audits read. Preserve every replay, inventory, source-history, artifact and support assertion; add fail-closed workflow contracts; refresh only the resulting current-source citations.
